rule: A control drawn for a login whose cards its own action refuses (backlog #79sqf). scripts/check-control-activity.mjs fails on any finding not listed here and on any entry that is no longer a finding. Each entry is an unfixed fault or a recorded false positive from the check's first run (2026-11-11): FIX it and delete the entry, never treat it as a ruling that it is fine. Never add an entry to make a new control pass: draw the control only when can() asks the activity its action asks. Shrink-only.

entries.found: no gate; host page(s) admin/website/pages/[slug], admin/website do not imply website.content:edit, website.propose:edit
entries.reason: READ, FALSE POSITIVE (2026-11-11, #79sqf): the action is chosen by the same prop that gates it (`canEdit ? updateSitePage : proposeSitePage`), the submit button is drawn only under `canEdit || canPropose`, and the fields are readOnly otherwise. The check unions both actions' activities; the control cannot reach the one it lacks. Cause (a/b): a conditional action choice the check does not trace.
